const inp = $input.first().json;
const operation = String(inp.operation ?? "").trim();
const name = String(inp.name ?? "").trim();

let limit = Number(inp.limit);
limit = Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0 ? Math.min(20, Math.round(limit)) : 10;

const OPS = {
  tracks_by_artist: `
    MATCH (t:Track)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(a:Artist)
    WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($name)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:ON_ALBUM]->(al:Album)
    RETURN t.track_id AS track_id, t.title AS title, a.name AS artist, g.name AS genre,
           al.name AS album, t.release_year AS release_year, t.popularity AS popularity
    ORDER BY (toLower(a.name) = toLower($name)) DESC, t.popularity DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  genres_of_artist: `
    MATCH (a:Artist)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(t:Track)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre)
    WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($name)
    RETURN a.name AS artist, g.name AS genre, count(t) AS tracks
    ORDER BY tracks DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  artists_in_genre: `
    MATCH (a:Artist)-[:PLAYS_GENRE]->(g:Genre)
    WHERE toLower(g.name) = toLower($name)
    MATCH (a)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(t:Track)
    RETURN g.name AS genre, a.name AS artist, count(t) AS tracks
    ORDER BY tracks DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  subgenres_in_genre: `
    MATCH (s:Subgenre)-[:PART_OF]->(g:Genre)
    WHERE toLower(g.name) = toLower($name)
    MATCH (t:Track)-[:HAS_SUBGENRE]->(s)
    RETURN g.name AS genre, s.name AS subgenre, count(t) AS tracks
    ORDER BY tracks DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  top_tracks_in_genre: `
    MATCH (t:Track)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre)
    WHERE toLower(g.name) = toLower($name)
    MATCH (t)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(a:Artist)
    RETURN t.track_id AS track_id, t.title AS title, a.name AS artist, g.name AS genre,
           t.popularity AS popularity, t.release_year AS release_year
    ORDER BY t.popularity DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  tracks_on_album: `
    MATCH (t:Track)-[:ON_ALBUM]->(al:Album)
    WHERE toLower(al.name) CONTAINS toLower($name)
    MATCH (t)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(a:Artist)
    RETURN t.track_id AS track_id, t.title AS title, a.name AS artist, al.name AS album,
           al.release_year AS release_year
    ORDER BY al.name, t.title
    LIMIT $limit`,

  tracks_by_year: `
    MATCH (y:Year {value: toInteger($name)})<-[:RELEASED_IN]-(al:Album)<-[:ON_ALBUM]-(t:Track)
    MATCH (t)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(a:Artist)
    RETURN y.value AS year, t.track_id AS track_id, t.title AS title, a.name AS artist,
           al.name AS album, t.popularity AS popularity
    ORDER BY t.popularity DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  similar_tracks: `
    MATCH (seed:Track)
    WHERE toLower(seed.title) CONTAINS toLower($name)
    WITH seed ORDER BY (toLower(seed.title) = toLower($name)) DESC, seed.popularity DESC
    LIMIT 1
    MATCH (seed)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(o:Track)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(a:Artist)
    RETURN seed.track_id AS seed_track_id, seed.title AS seed_title,
           o.track_id AS track_id, o.title AS title, a.name AS artist,
           round(s.score * 1000) / 1000 AS similarity
    ORDER BY s.score DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  related_artists: `
    MATCH (a:Artist)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(t:Track)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(u:Track)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(o:Artist)
    WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) AND o <> a
    RETURN a.name AS artist, o.name AS related_artist,
           count(*) AS similar_track_links, round(avg(s.score) * 1000) / 1000 AS avg_similarity
    ORDER BY similar_track_links DESC
    LIMIT $limit`,

  artists_sharing_genre: `
    MATCH (a:Artist)-[:PLAYS_GENRE]->(g:Genre)<-[:PLAYS_GENRE]-(o:Artist)
    WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) AND o <> a
    RETURN a.name AS artist, o.name AS other_artist, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS shared_genres
    ORDER BY size(shared_genres) DESC
    LIMIT $limit`
};

if (!OPS[operation]) {
  throw new Error(`Ukendt operation '${operation}'. Gyldige: ${Object.keys(OPS).join(", ")}`);
}
if (!name) throw new Error("Input 'name' mangler.");

return [{ json: {
  neo4jBody: { statements: [{ statement: OPS[operation], parameters: { name, limit } }] },
  meta: { source: "Neo4j graph traversal (" + operation + ")",
          info: { operation, name } }
}}];
